content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends screening for presymptomatic type 1 diabetes by testing for the presence of islet autoantibodies. These autoantibodies include those targeting insulin, glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD), islet antigen-2 (IA-2), and zinc transporter 8 (ZnT8). The detection of multiple islet autoantibodies is a strong indicator of a significantly elevated risk for the future development of type 1 diabetes.
